name: Basic Zero-Shot Prompt
purpose: Baseline zero-shot instruction prompt to test unconstrained model bug-fixing behavior.
expected_improvements: Establishes a baseline for error identification and code repair.
limitations: No structured output schema (unpredictable free text)
No role definition or pedagogical grounding
Uses complex programming terminology unsuited for beginners
No error taxonomy, severity grading, or line numbers
No step-by-step debugging walkthrough or prevention tips
Fails to handle edge cases or acknowledge uncertainty
